## Personality

Milty Boulter harbors a strong aversion to being patronized. He particularly dislikes when others treat him like a sweet little boy or pat him on the head.

## History

Milty Boulter is the cousin of the late [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) Ellen, whom he attended a funeral for alongside his mother, Mrs. Simon's sister.

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011)_
